start_apptainer_jupyter_server: start a Jupyter kernel gateway server inside an Apptainer container with read-only binds and overlays
stop_apptainer_jupyter_server: stop the running Apptainer Jupyter server by sending SIGTERM then SIGKILL if needed
get_connection_info: get the JupyterConnectionInfo with host, port, and auth token for the running server
get_jupyter_client: get a JupyterClient instance connected to the Apptainer Jupyter kernel gateway server
use_context_manager: use ApptainerJupyterServer as a context manager to auto-start and auto-stop the server
